name: 48306 · Rochester Hls, MI
findings: ZIP 48306 (Rochester Hls) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48306 (Rochester Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48306 (Rochester Hls) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
